content.summary: The session explores using Kubernetes as an abstraction layer to orchestrate a heterogeneous connected‑home ecosystem, leveraging the Open Service Broker API to enable vendor‑agnostic device control and handle intermittent connectivity. content.title: Istio - The Weather Company's Journey
content.author: Nick Nellis & Fabio Oliveira
content.summary: The Weather Company shares its real‑world experience incrementally adopting Istio to gain fleet‑wide visibility, traffic control, and authorization for a high‑scale caching and routing platform handling billions of requests daily.

content.author: Piotr Szczesniak
content.summary: The session explores native Kubernetes signal pipelines—metrics, logs, and events—showing how to collect, ingest, and visualize them with tools like Prometheus and Grafana, and how to extend these pipelines for comprehensive monitoring from the perspectives of users, administrators, and vendors.

content.title: SAFE WG Deep Dive – Ray Colline, Google (Intermediate Skill Level)
content.summary: This deep‑dive session explores the Ray project and its Kubernetes integration (KubeRay), covering architecture, deployment patterns, and best practices for running AI/ML workloads at scale, including GPU utilization and model serving.

content.summary: This session dives into the Kubernetes Release SIG’s release process, describing the roles, responsibilities, risks, and how community members can contribute to release teams.
content.description: The Kubernetes Release Special Interest Group is focused on creating deliverable increments of value to the end-user community, as well as improving the process over time. This session will go through the release process, explain the various roles, risks, and responsibilities. It will also provide an onramp for anyone interested in volunteering for a release team position in the future.

content.summary: An in‑depth technical overview of Notary and The Update Framework (TUF), explaining how they secure software distribution and the recent enhancements that improve cloud‑native supply‑chain security for Kubernetes users.
